lines.text: Paul proposes revisiting the brothers in every town, but he refuses to take Mark, who had deserted them in Pamphylia.
After a sharp disagreement, Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Crete, while Paul chose Silas and traveled through Syria and Cilicia.
In Lystra, Paul found the disciple Timothy and circumcised him because the Jews there knew his father was Greek.
The Spirit of Jesus would not permit them to enter Galatia, so they passed by Mysia and went down to Troas.
Paul saw a night vision of a man of Macedonia pleading for help, and they got ready to leave, concluding God had called them.
